decisions.statement: A level is written as a whole number.
Each total is read off the persona's page rather than worked out here.
The points a rung takes are read off the closeness levels rather than spelled here.
A line says a persona's name before her level and her level before her total.
The personas sit with the largest total first.
Two personas on one total sit in the order of their names.
A total is floored to two decimal places rather than rounded.
Each column is written to the width of the widest entry in that column.
A persona with no total is counted rather than answered as zero.
A run answering no persona at all is refused.
A run adds no day up.
A run turns no figure into a color.

definition: the command saying each persona's relationship level and the total behind it
